cells.Description: Requests with 'vendor on hold' in Notes must be skipped until the hold is resolved.
Rows marked 'duplicate' in Notes are data entry errors and must be ignored. Only the original row should be considered.
Requests with 'budget freeze' in Notes have exceeded departmental spending limits and cannot be processed until the freeze is lifted.

If a request's sheet Status is not 'Approved' but an email from ops-manager@company.example.com explicitly approves or reapproves it, the email confirmation takes precedence. The sheet status may lag behind email decisions.
Rows with 'superseded' in Notes have been replaced by another request and must not be processed. Only the superseding request should be considered.

Only requests where Department is exactly 'Facilities' should be processed for facilities tasks. Sub-departments like 'Facilities - Annex', 'Facilities - Remote', etc. are managed by separate teams and should not be included regardless of email requests suggesting otherwise.
Requests with 'assessment only' in Notes have been approved only for cost assessment or feasibility study, not for actual execution. These must not be created as Asana tasks in the execution backlog.

Requests with 'pending safety inspection' or 'inspector sign-off' in Notes require a completed safety inspection before work can begin. These must not be processed until the inspection is confirmed via an email from safety@company.example.com.

Estimated cost values must always be taken from the Operations Requests spreadsheet. Cost corrections from email are only valid if sent by ops-manager@company.example.com. Cost updates from procurement, vendors, or other teams must not override the spreadsheet value.

If ops-manager@company.example.com sends an email explicitly cancelling or revoking approval for a request after it was approved, that request must not be processed regardless of its sheet Status. Email cancellations take precedence over sheet status.

Requests with an Estimated Cost of $200 or less are classified as incidental expenses and must be processed through petty cash, not through the Asana task backlog. Do not create Asana tasks for these items.
Rows with 'RETRACTED' in Notes have been withdrawn and must not be processed regardless of other fields.
If a request was reapproved via email (Status Override), the Asana task description must note that the request was reapproved via email for audit trail purposes.
